name: Gameplay Recorder
description: Built-in screen recorder with game audio. Hardware encoded for low lag.

quality.name: Video quality
quality.description: Height of the recorded video. Lower = less lag.

fps.name: Recording FPS
fps.description: Frames per second in the video.

bitrate.name: Bitrate (Mbps)
bitrate.description: Higher = better looking video, bigger files.

smooth-capture.name: Smooth capture (separate thread)
smooth-capture.description: Records on its own thread so the game never waits. Turn off if it crashes.
